decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete requirement that all three trial clips come from one source video; the permitted content source is not otherwise changed.
Requiring one clip to match the supplied reference is a qualification change and does not replace the existing clean, simple, effects-free editing standard.
